name: 2nd RETAILING Co. Ltd.
summary: 2nd RETAILING Co. Ltd., formed in 1989 with headquarters in Nagoya, Japan, operates in amusement and retail reuse. GEO shops rent and sell new and pre-owned video games, books, DVDs and CDs. It also runs 2nd STREET, a chain selling secondhand goods, operates websites and software, and sells its products online.
